notes.title: Son of the Dragon King - Steam Next Fest Broadcasting Event - February 10
notes.content:
Event Overview:
Join us for an exclusive broadcast event during the Steam Next Fest, where we dive into the mystical world of "Son of the Dragon King." Immerse yourself in the magic, uncover the secrets of the kingdom, 
and witness the rise of a hero!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/a06694fdfd7175a1bd41d25cecb294a419473694.jpg[/img]

Event Highlights:

Live Gameplay Showcase: Experience the game in action as our developers guide you through the mesmerizing landscapes, challenging quests, and powerful abilities of the Son of the Dragon King.

Developer Insights: Get behind-the-scenes insights into the making of the game. Learn about the inspiration, challenges, and the creative process that brought this fantastical world to life.

Q&A Session: Have burning questions about the game? Our developers will be live to answer your queries. Discover more about the lore, characters, and the future of the Son of the Dragon King.

Exclusive Sneak Peeks: Be the first to witness exclusive sneak peeks of upcoming features, expansions, and exciting updates planned for the game.

Date and Time:
📅 February 10
🕒 20:00 PM

How to Join:
Visit our Steam store page during the event, and you'll find a direct link to the broadcast. Don't miss this chance to be part of the adventure!

Spread the Word:
🔗 Share this event with your fellow gamers, friends, and anyone ready to embark on an unforgettable journey. The more, the merrier!

Follow Us:
Stay updated on all things "Son of the Dragon King" by following our [url=https://discord.gg/XKWkRauX]Discord channel[/url] and our official [url=https://twitter.com/SotDragonKing]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/sonofthedragonking/]FB[/url] page.

Let the adventure begin! 🌟🔥

notes.title: Son of the Dragon King Public Playtest
notes.content:
Greetings Heroes!

We hope you’ve enjoyed our demo so far, for those who would like to take the next step, we are now holding a Public Playtest!

The playtest will be done with our latest build, it is very important to us to hear what you think of Son of the Dragon King and we look forward to your feedback and suggestions. 

[url=https://discord.gg/ggmkWaeH6A]The Playtest will be held on our Discord server[/url], so make sure to jump in there and [url=https://forms.gle/pNRk8Q8Pd4Pi4fhg6]fill out the sign-up form here before February 16th![/url]

[b]We will be holding a giveaway of Steam Gift Cards for our testers that provide us with feedback at the end of our playtest![/b]

We can’t wait to welcome all our testers and commence the Public Playtest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/78d3bf1b497e637b66f972f13629809cdf832c93.png[/img]

notes.title: Son of the Dragon King - Dev Log 01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/b7080506864b093e877914efa75a6cc631f4950a.png[/img]

Venturing into the development journey of Son of the Dragon King unveils a tapestry of creativity, innovation, and dedication.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/049d72499cebd9acc3d74fb5097a0a908080ff8d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The game is crafted by a passionate team that brings together diverse talents and experiences. From seasoned game developers to artists deeply rooted in Oriental aesthetics, the synergy is palpable.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/0d0d76f4a13b515e3d1238d2d41f100b69c20a41.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The real-time combat system is a result of extensive prototyping, aiming to create a seamless and immersive experience for both PC and console gamers. The team delved into uncharted territories, blending classic beat 'em up elements with innovative mechanics.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/bb1dc8b8749cbb2355963fb5cf187036e718dbbf.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/fdcd41e608f9b0c8eca00bc0179ccb14fd924b23.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The visual style of the game is a meticulous fusion of vivid, realistically-styled graphics with influences from Oriental art. Every frame is a brushstroke that paints a picture of feudal Japan, capturing the spirit of the era.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/2ceb50bb0e2a5323c3bd70a9bb8e0bea3e665c7e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/3ebdc1d094fd6ba64f748a6d37b445dcd35910b7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Crafting in Son of the Dragon King is not just a game mechanic; it's an art form. The team carefully curated a system where each crafted item tells a story and adds layers to the player's strategic choices.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/b6ef0fef41008bcc560af53a93064cb2f5d20202.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/3eeba7565079cd8820bd238649475e2339b83e65.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The narrative is a labor of love, intricately weaving historical fiction with mythological depths. Storytellers and mythologists collaborated to create an immersive world where every character, every foe, has a tale to tell.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/333c30ff766bf7370a1cc460cac7e6ac41922521.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Throughout development, the team actively engaged with the gaming community. Regular updates, sneak peeks, and even player feedback played a pivotal role in shaping the game. The excitement of the players mirrored the enthusiasm of the developers.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/4b7b3ac511131169768fee9dc98072449381eea6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Sound design is not just a complement to the visuals; it's a character in itself. The game's audio landscape is crafted to evoke emotions, enhance the storytelling, and immerse players in the world of feudal Japan.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/22a4480f83533eb9a8afd287cb2554c33824c1ee.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Development is a journey filled with challenges. From perfecting combat mechanics to balancing the intricacies of crafting, the team faced obstacles head-on. Each challenge was an opportunity to innovate, resulting in a more refined and engaging game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/e1f812a1ad57398a525d0b57f1330788caf57c90.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609133/cddfbaa743959fe1ddcdb6a5b644d6a8f55dd7e2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The development story is an ongoing saga. Post-launch, the team is committed to providing enriching content updates, ensuring that players continue to find new challenges, stories, and adventures within the world they've helped shape.
[/list]
Son of the Dragon King is not just a game; it's a collaborative masterpiece born from the dedication of a team passionate about creating an unforgettable gaming experience. The journey from concept to reality is as thrilling as the adventures that await players in feudal Japan.

notes.title: Son of the Dragon King Demo Launched!
notes.content:
Greetings Heroes!

We are so excited to announce that Son of the Dragon King now has its first Demo build up and running on our Steam page! Smash, dash, and kick your way through the first 4 levels of our game for free!

In the demo you can encounter enchanted miners, outmaneuver yokai skeletons in a haunted graveyard, confront the townsfolk in a bewitched village, and explore the temple's first floor. Each stage is packed with challenges and a glimpse of the epic journey ahead!

We’d like to invite all our heroes to our community on [url=https://discord.gg/ggmkWaeH6A]Discord[/url] where you can talk about the game with the developers, report bugs, and give feedback.

Check out the demo below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576320/Son_of_the_Dragon_King/

That is all for now heroes! Follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/sonofthedragonking/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/SotDragonKing]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/sotdragonking/]Instagram[/url] for more developer updates and news!

notes.title: Son of the Dragon King at Nordic Game Helsinki!
notes.content:
Greetings Heroes!

We are excited to share with you that Son of the Dragon King has been selected to participate in the [b]Final Round of Nordic Game Pitch Battle at Nordic Game 2023![/b] 

We will be at the [b]Epicenter Helsinki venue on November 29th 18:00 EET[/b], [b]MeetToMatch Lounge Table 42![/b] Come and try it out and meet the dev!
